title: 第2291章 大志魔封第2290章 黄天武氏
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【不过余烬之法的缺陷也很明显，属于最耗符文根基的法子，大多数符文只能坚持个一两次，就会彻底成为废品。
不是到了关键战斗，这种用法没几个人用得起，因为但凡能够使用余烬的符文，炼制难度与珍稀程度都已经不比八环造化道品的符箓低。
【你耗时八年时间，这才将夺心魔的意识彻底消无，让它变成了死物“魔封之灵”
接下来，你便可以用魔封之法封炼，而你选择封炼的目标，便是帝兵天成方矩。
封炼目标有很多选择，但想要提高魔封的成功率，选择的目标越强越好。
帝兵，便是其中一个，可以承受住各种杂乱且冲的气息，收到的影响还相对较少。
而比起才拿到手的龙冠，天成方矩与你联系的时间更长，也你更放心……】
【你耗时三个多月时间，将夺心魔炼制而成的魔封之灵封入天成方矩中，也临时找了一个较为安全的空间，布下了简单的阵法与禁制。
在这空间之外，有苍灵与墨骨守着，空间内则有琳手持黑魔法药物，成为你第二护道，这才开始做着封炼的最后准备……】
【同年，又过去了五个多月时间。
你自认为已经万事俱备，做到了自己可以做的所有准备，便也开始施展起“大志魔封”
术法。
【第三百九十万零五千三百八十九年，耗费近两年时间，大致魔封的最后一道印灵进入了天成方矩，并顺着引向了天成方矩内已经封炼到最后关头的魔封之灵……
不多久，同一天的傍晚时分，接连有两道天外神雷劈下，指向了天成方矩的位置……在这之后不久，便又有灵雨降下，锦鲤虚影仙祝、万朵莲池空涌。
【你已经拉开了与天成方矩的距离，只在旁观，没有任何插手。
直到一切福相消失，这才靠近引来天成方矩到手中。
简单观察，你发现这一件帝兵并无半点受到伤害的迹象，此前的两道神雷对它没有造成什么影响，这使你心下稍安。
第一次尝试，总是担心会有意外发生，而最怕的便是这种捡了芝麻丢了西瓜的事情。
确定这一点后，你这才有心思关心封炼的结果，借着再向内探去。
天成方矩内的灵韵更加充盈，已是有不少封炼中多余的灵韵游离，现在也都成了天成方矩的营养。
换做是他人看向此时的天成方矩，则会因这些无序的灵韵而阻隔，更难看破现在的天成方矩，但这些对你却不会发生，你感受不到半点阻扰。
很快你就探到了内中亲手制成的灵脉，在这里找到了那件正在散发着异样书香的物品，也正是一道白色符文……】
【只观其形，你就已经感觉有些不妙，等到真正从天成方矩内取出，入了手后，你则心情更加糟糕。
这符文入手后，你就已经知晓这是一枚“无心”
符文。
而无心符文，虽然在上庭天大势力中算不得出名，但也不算太过于荒僻。
content_en:
[However, the flaws of the Ember method are also obvious. It is the method that consumes the most rune foundation. Most runes can only be persisted once or twice before they become completely useless.
Unless it's a critical battle, not many people can afford to use this method, because any rune that can use embers is no less difficult and rare to refine than the rune of an eight-ring creation artifact.
[It took you eight years to completely eliminate the mind flayer's consciousness and turn it into a dead creature, the "Demon Sealed Spirit"
Next, you can use the magic sealing method to seal, and the goal you choose to seal is to make the emperor's weapons perfect.
There are many choices for sealing targets, but if you want to increase the success rate of magic sealing, the stronger the target you choose, the better.
The Imperial Soldier is one of them. It can withstand all kinds of messy and aggressive auras and is relatively less affected.
And compared to the dragon crown you just got, Tiancheng Fangju has been in contact with you for a longer time, and you feel more at ease...]
[You spent more than three months to seal the demon-sealed spirit refined by the Mind Flayer into the Heavenly Square. You also temporarily found a safer space and set up simple formations and restrictions.
Outside this space, there are Cangling and Mogu guarding it, and inside the space, Lin is holding black magic medicine, becoming your second protector, and then she begins to make the final preparations for the sealing...]
[In the same year, more than five months passed.
You think that everything is ready and you have made all the preparations you can make, so you also start to use the "Demon Sealing of Ambition"
magic.
[In the 39005389th year, after nearly two years of work, the last demon-sealed seal spirit entered Tiancheng Square, and followed it to the demon-sealed spirit that had been sealed to the last moment in Tiancheng Square...
Not long after, in the evening of the same day, two divine thunders from the sky struck down one after another, pointing at the location of the Tiancheng Square... Shortly after, there was another spiritual rain, koi shadows and immortal blessings, and thousands of lotus ponds emptied out.
[You have distanced yourself from Tiancheng Fangju and are only watching without any intervention.
It wasn't until all the blessings disappeared that he came close to attracting the Heavenly Fangju into his hands.
After a simple observation, you found that this imperial weapon showed no signs of being harmed. The two previous divine thunders had no impact on it, which made you feel a little at ease.
When I try it for the first time, I am always worried that something unexpected will happen. What I am most afraid of is picking up sesame seeds and losing watermelons.
After confirming this, you will be able to care about the results of the sealing process, and then explore within.
The aura within Tiancheng Fangju is more abundant, and a lot of the excess aura in the sealing process has been released, and now it has become the nourishment of Tiancheng Fangju.
If other people look at the natural order at this time, they will be blocked by these disordered auras, and it will be more difficult to see through the natural order. But this will not happen to you, and you will not feel any obstruction.
Soon you found the spiritual veins made by yourself, and found the item that was exuding a strange scholarly fragrance, which was also a white rune...]
[Just looking at its shape, you already feel a little bad. When you actually take it out of the Tiancheng Square and get it in your hands, your mood becomes even worse.
After you get this rune, you already know that it is an "unintentional" one.
runes.
As for the Wuxin rune, although it is not famous among the great forces in Shangtingtian, it is not too remote.
